name: Kelp

low.description: About 2 tablespoons dried or 1/4 cup fresh

siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated for SIBO as it's naturally low FODMAP. However, some individuals may be sensitive to the high iodine content.
preparationTips: Rinse dried kelp before use to remove excess salt
Soak dried kelp for 10-15 minutes before cooking
Add to soups and broths for umami flavor
Use sparingly due to intense flavor and high iodine content
alternatives: Regular spinach or kale for similar mineral content
nutritionalHighlights: Very high in iodine for thyroid function
Good source of folate and vitamin K
